items.name: adguard_url
items.description: Base URL of AdGuard Home's API on the router (HTTPS). An IP, so it doesn't depend on the DNS it reads from.

items.name: adguard_cert_sha256
items.description: Hex sha256 of AdGuard Home's self-signed certificate (DER), which is trusted instead of a CA.

items.name: router_name
items.description: Value of the router field on every query written, to tell routers apart.

items.name: poll_interval
items.description: How often to read AdGuard Home's query log, as a Go duration. Each poll pages back to the last one, so this sets latency, not completeness.

items.name: request_timeout
items.description: Timeout for each request to AdGuard Home or VictoriaLogs, as a Go duration.

items.name: victorialogs_urls
items.description: Every VictoriaLogs replica to write to. Each gets every query (the cluster's replicas are independent copies, written to in parallel).

items.name: buffer_limit
items.description: Most queries held in memory per VictoriaLogs replica while it can't be reached; beyond this the oldest are dropped.
